371.evidence: PORTED (javap vs both jars): the minecraft:weapon component (Weapon record: itemDamagePerAttack, disableBlockingForSeconds) does NOT exist in 1.21.4 — it arrives in 1.21.5 — so the Rust's weapon_damage (read from c["minecraft:weapon"]) was None for every item in the 1.21.4 tree and weapon_wear never fired: no melee weapon ever lost durability on a hit. The shield-disable path is unaffected: shield_disable_seconds already keys off the #minecraft:axes tag (5.0s), not the Weapon component.
